test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I don’t like dirty cars, so you should keep it ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence suggests a preference for cleanliness** ("I don’t like dirty cars").**
 
• **"Spotless" **means completely clean, which aligns with the preference stated in the sentence.
 
• The other options **(similar, new, shabby)** do not fit the context of maintaining cleanliness.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** ***"I don’t like dirty cars, so you should keep it spotless."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Similar:** Resembling without being identical.
 
• **New:** Recently made or obtained.
 
• **Shabby:** In poor condition through long use or lack of care.
 
• **No error:** This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is a clear preference for cleanliness stated.
